_comment: Per-section parameters of a GraFx resource's grafx1.txt (/extra/GRAFX/<n>-name/). Same entry format as parameters.json so widget_factory.create_parameter_widget can render them. 'relevant_attributes': the accents= attribute characters that make this parameter do anything (empty = always relevant). 'relevant_states': the sections where it applies (absent = all). Source: CFX manual rev 1.19, 'GraFx parameters' and 'GraFx pixel attributes' (p.172-174). 'default': the value a parameter starts at when it's first switched on in the editor (not a firmware default).

delay.description: Milliseconds per stage (BMP line) - the frame rate of the sequenced animation, and the duration of each morphing step. Unset or 0: playback speed is adjusted automatically to the duration of the sound fx (or quick-on) for perfect synchronization. In practice it's capped at the refreshfx rate (~10 ms).

many.description: How many BMP files exist for this state (<prefix>1.bmp, <prefix>2.bmp, ...). The board picks one at random each time the state is entered, but only within this count - it doesn't scan the folder, so extra files beyond it never play.

stop.description: Stop at the end of the BMP instead of looping - for transient effects like power on/off and pre-on/post-off. For a frame-accurate pre-on, stop=1 also prevents rolling back to the start if timing rounding leaves a frame over.

accpulsed.description: Self-pulsing pixels depth: how deep the pulsing dims the pixel color. Works the same as the regular accent LEDs.

accpulsel.description: Self-pulsing period in milliseconds (one full up-down cycle).

magiclow.description: Black / dark level of magnetic-field-controlled pixels (M, C, S, T, A attributes; 9-axis CFX only). Brightness is mapped from {magiclow ; magic score} to {0 ; 100}%. Below the quiescent magic score, the pixels shine without 'force activation'; the higher it is, the closer the magnet has to be. Check the live score with the serial command logmagic=1.

colorshift_intensity.description: For color shifting pixels (H attribute): how much of the blade color is mixed over the white pixels of the BMP.

colorshift_threshold.description: For color shifting pixels (H attribute): how much dark detail is preserved. Start around 10-20.

power.description: Local brightness of the sequence. On a GraFx blade this only applies to the blade-off IDLE sequence - the other sequences' brightness comes from the blade profile's bladepower and the global masterpower.

a.name: Sequenced
a.description: Regular sequenced pixel - color comes straight from the BMP, changing instantly at each stage.

m.name: Morphing
m.description: Morphing pixel - fades progressively from one stage's color to the next over the stage duration (10 ms steps).

r.name: Random RGB
r.description: Random color each stage, picked totally randomly over RGB values.

R.name: Random wheel
R.description: Random color each stage, picked from the 256-color wheel at max brightness (rainbow).

~.name: Pulse
~.description: Self-pulsing, using the BMP pixel color (accpulsed depth, accpulsel period). The color can change over time in the BMP.

^.name: Pulse inverted
^.description: Same as ~ with an inverted variation.

B.name: Pulse blade color
B.description: Self-pulsing using the blade color only (follows color profile changes).

I.name: Pulse blade color inv.
I.description: Self-pulsing with the blade color, inverted.

X.name: Pulse crystal color
X.description: Self-pulsing using the crystal color only (follows color profile changes).

L.name: Pulse crystal color inv.
L.description: Self-pulsing with the crystal color, inverted.

@.name: Audio flicker
@.description: Flickers on the audio beat - volume controls brightness, the BMP controls the color.

#.name: Audio flicker inverted
#.description: Reverse audio flicker - the beat dims the pixel. Color from the BMP.

*.name: Audio flicker blade color
*.description: Audio flicker applied to the blade color (color profile).

$.name: Audio flicker crystal color
$.description: Audio flicker applied to the crystal color (color profile).

s.name: Ledstrip mirror
s.description: Uses the color of pixel #1 of the main blade.

p.name: PLI single pixel
p.description: PLI indicator on one pixel - green, yellow, orange, red over the PLI scale.

P.name: PLI range
P.description: PLI over a range of pixels - turns BMP pixels on/off depending on PLI voltage vs. the scale defined by the BMP.

M.name: Magnetic blade color
M.description: Magic score mapped to the blade color brightness (9-axis CFX only; dark level set by magiclow).

C.name: Magnetic crystal color
C.description: Magic score blends the crystal color.

S.name: Magnetic pulse blade
S.description: Magnetic field controls blade color self-pulsing.

T.name: Magnetic pulse crystal
T.description: Magnetic field controls crystal color self-pulsing.

A.name: Magnetic reveal
A.description: Magic score controls the brightness of the BMP sequence - a stronger field reveals the animated pixels.

H.name: Color shift
H.description: White BMP pixels are replaced dynamically with the blade color (colorshift_intensity / colorshift_threshold).
